title: Bike Bar Ithaca
venue_description:
Bike Bar Ithaca

Bike Bar is a bicycle-themed taproom in the heart of downtown Ithaca, pouring a dozen rotating craft beers alongside signature cocktails, wine, cider and non-alcoholic options. Bicycle frames, wheels and cycling memorabilia line the walls, giving the room a distinct hobbyist identity that sets it apart from Ithaca's other downtown bars.

Atmosphere and Setting

The vibe is casual and unpretentious — a neighborhood taproom with charcuterie and cheese plates rather than a full kitchen, and a weekday happy hour that draws an after-work crowd before the evening's live music or jam session gets underway.

Old-Time Jam

Every Tuesday evening, fiddler Joe Hayward and friends lead an old-time music jam that has become a fixture of Ithaca's acoustic-music community. String players — fiddle, banjo, guitar, mandolin — are welcome to bring an instrument and sit in on traditional tunes in a relaxed, circle-style format rather than a formal stage show.

Other Programming

Beyond the Tuesday jam, Bike Bar books scheduled live sets spanning jazz, reggae and folk throughout the month, announced primarily through its Instagram and Facebook pages.

For Performers

The old-time jam is genuinely informal — there's no sign-up sheet or stage, just a standing invitation to bring an acoustic instrument and join the circle.

Good to Know

Bike Bar is located at 314 E State St, Ithaca, NY 14850. The taproom is open from 4:00 PM daily, with the old-time jam typically running in the early evening.

title: Liquid State Brewing Company
venue_description:
Liquid State Brewing Company

Liquid State Brewing Company operates a 2,800-square-foot beer hall and patio in Ithaca's West End District, pouring house-brewed beer alongside a small-plates menu and rotating local food trucks. Since opening, the brewery has positioned itself as a community gathering space for West End residents and Ithaca visitors alike, with a calendar of events that goes well beyond typical brewery programming.

Atmosphere and Setting

The beer hall is spacious and casual, with indoor seating and an outdoor patio that gets heavy use in warmer months. The West End location puts it a short walk or bike ride from downtown Ithaca and the Cayuga Waterfront Trail.

Bluegrass Night

On select Monday evenings, typically from about 5:30 PM to 8:30 PM, Liquid State hosts a Bluegrass Night session that draws local pickers and string players for a relaxed evening of acoustic bluegrass and old-time music.

Other Programming

The brewery's weekly calendar is unusually varied for a taproom: Irish traditional music sessions with Six Mile Craic, a comedy open mic, a trivia night hosted by a local author, and the recurring “Astronomy on Tap” science lecture series all rotate through the space.

For Performers

Bluegrass Night is an informal, bring-your-own-instrument jam rather than a ticketed showcase, making it approachable for pickers visiting Ithaca as well as local regulars.

Good to Know

Liquid State Brewing Company is located at 620 West Green St, Ithaca, NY 14850. Because Bluegrass Night runs on select Mondays rather than weekly, check the brewery's online events calendar to confirm the next date before visiting.

title: The Nocturnal Cafe
venue_description:
The Nocturnal Café

The Nocturnal Café is an all-ages, alcohol-free espresso and tea bar in downtown Ithaca, grown out of the decade-old Sacred Root Kava Lounge & Tea Bar. The café bills itself as “Ithaca's underground sanctuary” and its only alcohol-free nightlife destination, offering specialty espresso drinks, curated teas and THC-free mocktail elixirs in a cozy, softly lit space.

Atmosphere and Setting

The room leans into an intimate, underground feel — twinkling string lights on the ceiling and tables, and couches spread across several small connected rooms. Because there's no alcohol, the crowd skews younger and more all-ages than most Ithaca nightlife, and the vibe stays consistently welcoming rather than rowdy.

Wednesday Open Mic Night

Every Wednesday from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM, the café hosts a free, all-ages open mic featuring a rotating cast of local performers — musicians, storytellers and poets alike — in front of what regulars describe as a genuinely supportive audience. Slots fill quickly, so performers are encouraged to arrive close to the start time.

Other Programming

Beyond the weekly open mic, The Nocturnal Café hosts live music, DJ and groove nights and rotating local art displays, serving Ithaca's sober-curious and all-ages crowd.

For Performers

Because the venue is alcohol-free and all-ages, it's one of the most approachable rooms in Ithaca for younger performers or anyone looking for a substance-free open mic experience.

Good to Know

The Nocturnal Café is located at 103 S Geneva St, Ithaca, NY 14850. It's closed on Sundays; the open mic runs every Wednesday night.

title: The Westy
venue_description:
The Westy

The Westy is a neighborhood bar in Ithaca's West End, built around a wide selection of craft beers, spirits and a spacious beer garden out back. Darts, a pool table, a pinball machine, popcorn and a piano round out a bar that leans into being a genuine local hangout rather than a polished cocktail lounge.

Atmosphere and Setting

The Westy is open seven days a week starting at 4:00 PM, with a relaxed early-evening crowd that builds into a livelier, more sociable scene as the night goes on — especially on open mic nights, when the room's energy tends to climb along with the lineup.

Open Mic Night

Every Tuesday from 9:00 PM to 11:00 PM, The Westy hosts a 21-and-up open mic. It's a newer addition to Ithaca's open mic circuit compared to some of the city's longtime rooms, but it has quickly found a following among performers who want a real bar-room crowd rather than a quiet listening room.

Other Programming

The Westy's beer garden and game room also host casual live music and community gatherings throughout the week, in keeping with its neighborhood-bar identity.

For Performers

Because the open mic is 21-and-up, performers should bring ID; the house piano is available for anyone who wants to use it rather than bringing their own instrument.

Good to Know

The Westy is located at 516 W State St, Ithaca, NY 14850, in Ithaca's West End neighborhood.

title: Crossroads Bar & Grille
venue_description:
Crossroads Bar & Grille

Crossroads Bar & Grille is a family-style restaurant and bar in Lansing, just north of Ithaca, serving a full food menu alongside a well-stocked bar in a welcoming, unpretentious setting.

Atmosphere and Setting

Crossroads reads as a genuine community hangout for the Lansing and greater Ithaca area — family-friendly earlier in the evening, with a livelier bar scene once the kitchen winds down and live music takes over.

Open Mic Night

On Thursday evenings from about 6:30 PM to 9:00 PM, Crossroads hosts an open mic led by local musician Benny T, drawing performers from Lansing, Ithaca and the surrounding Tompkins County towns for a casual night of acoustic and full-band sets.

Other Programming

Crossroads is a regular stop for local bands throughout the year, making it one of the more consistent live-music venues just outside Ithaca proper.

For Performers

The open mic is casual and welcoming to both solo acoustic acts and full bands, with house sound available for anyone who needs it.

Good to Know

Crossroads Bar & Grille is located at 3120 N Triphammer Road, Lansing, NY 14882, about a 10-minute drive from downtown Ithaca.
